High Performance Switching Hardware Platform
Version: V1.26
Release Date: 2024/10/08
Platform Overview
PeakNetX platform is a purpose-built Ethernet switching platform to address the growing demand
for extreme low latency/jitter, comprehensive end-to-end tunnel network and high speed in the era
of edge computing and AI. PeakNetX platform provides superb flexible I/O connectivity capability,
support full-range port speeds from 10G to 100G
Key Features of the PeaknetX Platform
l Ethernet capabilities: MAC table, Vxlan, IPFIX, ACL, EVC etc.
l Full set of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocol
l Rich OAM
l Security feature set
l Precision timing protocol
